notes: Share-page text whose speaker-line text is followed in the next line by a digit ('Version 1' before 'Version 10') and by a combining mark ('Cafe' before 'Cafe' with U+0301).

Apple discards the text after the header whenever more text follows. The web app keeps it here: the next line begins with it, but continues with a digit in one turn and with a combining mark in the other, so the text does not end where a word ends and is the first line of the turn.
